verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
translations.ron: Atunci a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi cu Aaron şi a zis:

verses.geez:
ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ በበሥርዐቱ ፡ ወበበ ፡ ትእምርቱ ፡ ወበበቤተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ይትዐየኑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አንጻረ ፡
                  ዐውደ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ይትዐየኑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: Let the children of Israel encamp fronting each other, every man keeping his own rank, according to their standards, according to the houses of their families; the children of Israel shall encamp round about the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: Let the children of Israel encamp fronting each other, every man keeping his own rank, according to their standards, according to the houses of their families; the children of Israel shall encamp round about the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
translations.ron: "Fiii lui Israel să poposească fiecare lângă steagul său, în preajma semnelor familiei sale, şi să-şi aşeze taberele înaintea cortului mărturiei şi împrejurul lui.

verses.geez:
ወእለ ፡ ይቀድሙ ፡ ተዓይኖ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ይኅድር ፡ ተዓይነ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ወመልአኮሙኒ ፡
                  ለደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ነአሶን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሚናዳብ ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp first toward the east shall be the order of the camp of Juda with their host, and the prince of the sons of Juda, Naasson the son of Aminadab.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp first toward the east shall be the order of the camp of Juda with their host, and the prince of the sons of Juda, Naasson the son of Aminadab.
translations.kjv: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
translations.ron: Întâi, spre răsărit, să poposească steagul taberei lui Iuda, cu cetele sale, cu Naason, fiul lui Aminadab, căpetenia fiilor lui Iuda,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፯፻-፻፵፻፯፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were seventy-four thousand and six hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were seventy-four thousand and six hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de şaptezeci şi patru de mii şase sute.

verses.geez: ወእምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ይትዓየኑ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ይስካር ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ይስካር ፡ ናታናኤል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሶገር ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Issachar, and the prince of the sons of Issachar shall be Nathanael the son of Sogar.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Issachar, and the prince of the sons of Issachar shall be Nathanael the son of Sogar.
translations.kjv: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
translations.ron: Alături să poposească seminţia lui Isahar, cu Natanael, fiul lui Ţuar, căpetenia fiilor lui Isahar,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፭፻-፻፵፻፬፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were fifty-four thousand and four hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were fifty-four thousand and four hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de cincizeci şi patru de mii patru sute.

verses.geez: ወእምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ይትዓየኑ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ዛቡሎን ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዛቡሎን ፡ ኤልያብ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኬሎን ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Zabulon, and the prince of the sons of Zabulon shall be Eliab the son of Chælon.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Zabulon, and the prince of the sons of Zabulon shall be Eliab the son of Chælon.
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
translations.ron: Mai departe va poposi seminţia lui Zabulon, cu Eliab, fiul lui Helon, căpetenia fiilor lui Zabulon,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፭፻-፻፸፻፬፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were fifty-seven thousand and four hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were fifty-seven thousand and four hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
translations.ron: Cu oştenii săi în număr de cincizeci şi şapte de mii patru sute.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ፲፻-፻[፰]፻-፻፷፻፬፻ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡
                  ይቀድሙ ፡ አንሥኦ ።
verses.translation: All that were numbered of the camp of Juda were a hundred and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred: they shall move first with their forces.

translations.lxx: All that were numbered of the camp of Juda were a hundred and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred: they shall move first with their forces.
translations.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
translations.ron: Toţi aceştia în număr de o sută optzeci şi şase de mii patru sute, care ţin de tabăra lui Iuda, să plece întâi.

verses.geez:
ወየኀድር ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ መንገለ ፡ አዜብ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ [ኤ]ሊሱር ፡
                  ወልደ ፡ ሴድዩር ፤
verses.translation: This is the order of the camp of Ruben; their forces shall be toward the south, and the prince of the children of Ruben shall be Elisur the son of Sediur.

translations.lxx: This is the order of the camp of Ruben; their forces shall be toward the south, and the prince of the children of Ruben shall be Elisur the son of Sediur.
translations.kjv: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
translations.ron: Spre miazăzi să se aşeze tabăra lui Ruben, cu cetele sale şi Eliţur, fiul lui Şedeur, căpetenia fiilor lui Ruben,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፬፻-፻፷፻፭፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were forty-six thousand and five hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were forty-six thousand and five hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de patruzeci şi şase de mii cinci sute.

verses.geez: ወይትዐየኑ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ሰለሚ[ዬል] ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሱሪስዴ ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next to him shall be of the tribe of Symeon, and the prince of the sons of Symeon shall be Salamiel the son of Surisadai.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next to him shall be of the tribe of Symeon, and the prince of the sons of Symeon shall be Salamiel the son of Surisadai.
translations.kjv: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translations.ron: Lângă el va poposi seminţia lui Simeon, cu Şelumiel, fiul lui Ţurişadai, căpetenia fiilor lui Simeon,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኅይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፭፻-፻፺፻፫፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were fifty-nine thousand and three hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were fifty-nine thousand and three hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de cincizeci şi nouă de mii trei sute.

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ኤሊሳፍ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ራጉኤል ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next to them shall be the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the sons of Gad, Elisaph the son of Raguel.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next to them shall be the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the sons of Gad, Elisaph the son of Raguel.
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
translations.ron: După acesta va poposi seminţia lui Gad, cu Eliasaf, fiul lui Raguel, căpetenia fiilor lui Gad,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፬፻-፻፶፻፯፻፶ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were forty-five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were forty-five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de patruzeci şi cinci de mii şase sute cincizeci.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ፲፻-፻፭፻-፻[፲፻፬፻፶] ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ወበዳግም ፡
                  ያነሥኡ ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.translation: All who were numbered of the camp of Ruben, were a hundred and fifty-one thousand and four hundred and fifty: they with their forces shall proceed in the second place.

translations.lxx: All who were numbered of the camp of Ruben, were a hundred and fifty-one thousand and four hundred and fifty: they with their forces shall proceed in the second place.
translations.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
translations.ron: Toţi aceştia cu luptătorii lor în număr de o sută cincizeci şi una de mii patru sute cincizeci, care ţin de tabăra lui Ruben, rânduiţi în tabere, vor pleca în rândul al doilea.

verses.geez:
ወይትነሣእ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ መርጡል ፡ ወትዕይነቶሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ በከመ ፡ ይትዐየኑ ፡ ከማሁ ፡
                  ያነሥኡ ፡ ፩፩ ፡ ዘዘ ፡ ይታለዉ ፡ በበምስፍናሁ ።
verses.translation: And then the tabernacle of witness shall be set forward, and the camp of the Levites shall be between the camps; as they shall encamp, so also shall they commence their march, each one next in order to his fellow according to their companies.

translations.lxx: And then the tabernacle of witness shall be set forward, and the camp of the Levites shall be between the camps; as they shall encamp, so also shall they commence their march, each one next in order to his fellow according to their companies.
translations.kjv: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
translations.ron: După aceea, când va pleca cortul adunării, tabăra leviţilor va fi în mijlocul taberelor şi precum au poposit aşa să şi plece, fiecare la rândul său şi sub steagul său.

verses.geez:
ወየኀድር ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ገጸ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ኤሊሳማ ፡
                  ወልደ ፡ ኤሚዩድ ፤
verses.translation: The station of the camp of Ephraim shall be westward with their forces, and the head of the children of Ephraim shall be Elisama the son of Emiud.

translations.lxx: The station of the camp of Ephraim shall be westward with their forces, and the head of the children of Ephraim shall be Elisama the son of Emiud.
translations.kjv: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
translations.ron: Spre apus va poposi tabăra lui Efraim cu cetele sale şi cu Elişama, fiul lui Amihud, căpetenia fiilor lui Efraim,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፬፻-፻፭የ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, are forty thousand and five hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, are forty thousand and five hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de patruzeci de mii cinci sute.

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ ገማልዬል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ፋዳሱር ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Manasse, and the prince of the sons of Manasse, Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Manasse, and the prince of the sons of Manasse, Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.
translations.kjv: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
translations.ron: Lângă ea se va aşeza seminţia lui Manase cu Gamaliel, fiul lui Pedaţur, căpetenia fiilor lui Manase,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ [፫]፻-፻፳፻፪፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were thirty-two thousand and two hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were thirty-two thousand and two hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de treizeci şi două de mii două sute.

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ አቢዳን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ጋዴዮን ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Benjamin, and the prince of the sons of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gadeoni.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Benjamin, and the prince of the sons of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gadeoni.
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
translations.ron: După acesta seminţia lui Veniamin cu Abidan, fiul lui Ghedeon, căpetenia fiilor lui Veniamin,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፫፻-፻፶፻፬፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were thirty-five thousand and four hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were thirty-five thousand and four hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii lui în număr de treizeci şi cinci de mii patru sute.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ፲፻-፻፹[፻ወ፻] ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ወበሣልስ ፡ ያነሥኡ
                  ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.translation: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim, were one hundred and eight thousand and one hundred: they with their forces shall set out third.

translations.lxx: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim, were one hundred and eight thousand and one hundred: they with their forces shall set out third.
translations.kjv: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
translations.ron: Toţi aceştia cu luptătorii lor în număr de o sută opt mii o sută, care ţin de tabăra lui Efraim, vor pleca în al treilea rând, aşezaţi în cete.

verses.geez:
ወየኀድሩ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ዳን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ገጸ ፡ መስዕ ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዳን ፡ አኪየዜር ፡
                  ወልደ ፡ አሚሳዴ ፤
verses.translation: The order of the camp of Dan shall be northward with their forces; and the prince of the sons of Dan, Achiezer the son of Amisadai.

translations.lxx: The order of the camp of Dan shall be northward with their forces; and the prince of the sons of Dan, Achiezer the son of Amisadai.
translations.kjv: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
translations.ron: La miazănoapte se va aşeza tabăra lui Dan cu cetele sale şi cu Ahiezer, fiul lui Amişadai, căpetenia fiilor lui Dan,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፯፻-፻፳፻፯፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were sixty-two thousand and seven hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were sixty-two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de şaizeci şi două de mii şapte sute.

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ አሴር ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አሴር ፡ ፋጌሔል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤክራን ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Aser; and the prince of the sons of Aser, Phagiel the son of Echran.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Aser; and the prince of the sons of Aser, Phagiel the son of Echran.
translations.kjv: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
translations.ron: Lângă el îşi va aşeza tabăra seminţia lui Aşer, cu Paghiel, fiul lui Ocran, căpetenia fiilor lui Aşer,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፬፻-፻፲፻፭፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de patruzeci şi una de mii cinci sute.

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ ፡ በገቦሆሙ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ንፍታሌም ፡ ወመልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ንፍታሌም ፡ አኪሬ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤናን ፤
verses.translation: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Nephthali; and the prince of the children of Nephthali, Achire son of Ænan.

translations.lxx: And they that encamp next shall be of the tribe of Nephthali; and the prince of the children of Nephthali, Achire son of Ænan.
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
translations.ron: Mai departe îşi va aşeza tabăra seminţia lui Neftali cu Ahira, fiul lui Enan, căpetenia fiilor lui Neftali,

verses.geez: ምስለ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፭፻-፻፴፻፬፻ ።
verses.translation: His forces that were numbered were fifty-three thousand and four hundred.

translations.lxx: His forces that were numbered were fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
translations.ron: Şi cu oştenii săi în număr de cincizeci şi trei de mii patru sute.

verses.geez:
ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ዳን ፡ ፲፻-፻፭፻-፻[፸፻]፯፻ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደኃርያን ፡ ያነሥኡ ፡
                  በከመ ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ ።
verses.translation: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan, were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand and six hundred: they shall set out last according to their order.

translations.lxx: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan, were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand and six hundred: they shall set out last according to their order.
translations.kjv: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
translations.ron: Toţi aceştia cu luptătorii lor în număr de o sută cincizeci şi şapte de mii şase sute, care ţin de tabăra lui Dan, să plece la urmă sub steagurile lor şi rânduiţi în cete".

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በበአብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኍልቈ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡
                  ፷፻-፻፴፻፭፻፶ ።
verses.translation: This is the numbering of the children of Israel according to the houses of their families: all the numbering of the camps with their forces, was six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

translations.lxx: This is the numbering of the children of Israel according to the houses of their families: all the numbering of the camps with their forces, was six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
translations.kjv: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
translations.ron: Aceştia sunt fiii lui Israel care au intrat la numărătoare după familiile lor. Toţi, câţi au intrat la numărătoare pe tabere şi pe cete, erau şase sute trei mii cinci sute cincizeci.

verses.geez: ወሌዋውያንሰ ፡ ኢተኈለቁ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: But the Levites were not numbered with them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: But the Levites were not numbered with them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Iar leviţii nu s-au numărat cu ei, după cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ተዓየኑ ፡ በበሥርዐቶሙ ፡
                  ወከማሁ ፡ ያነሥኡሂ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ነገዶሙ ፡ ዘዘ ፡ ዚአሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did all things that the Lord commanded Moses; thus they encamped in their order, and thus they began their march in succession each according to their divisions, according to the houses of their families.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel did all things that the Lord commanded Moses; thus they encamped in their order, and thus they began their march in succession each according to their divisions, according to the houses of their families.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut fiii lui Israel toate câte poruncise Domnul lui Moise: aşa se aşezau în tabere sub steagurile lor şi aşa purcedeau fiecare cu seminţia sa şi cu familia sa.
